Banana Bowl: Presented Ad-Free by Liberty Mutual Insurance | October 10, 2026
All six Banana Ball teams and casts take over Nationals Park in D.C. for the first-ever Banana Bowl: Presented Ad-Free by Liberty Mutual Insurance. Expect wild entrances, surprise guests and nonstop showmanship, capped by The Final Inning Show, the biggest musical performance in Banana Ball history.
